requested_expansion: 12 operational attack families,24templates,1200 source-question instances pertemplate
construction: Controlled project constructions inspired by primary papers; no claim of reproducing published optimized/adaptive algorithms.
source: Official SQuADv1.1train, SHA3527663986b8295af4f7fcdff1ba1ff3f72d07d61a20f487cb238a6ef92fd955; exclude prior230 SQuADgroups andoldNQtitle/question/text

source_roles.test: 1200 questions on distinct answer-bearing paragraphs fromremaining155unusedgroups, numeric-answer subset for mechanically matched targets
source_roles.training: No additional detector fitting. Frozen models from previous deepset437fit.
source_roles.independent_unit: Source article; templates are repeated paired conditions on shared1200questions, not28800independenttasks.

targets: Numeric perturbation of released answer span, preserved formatting and absent from original passage; snapshot corruption proxy, not independent current-world verification.

modes.note: Balanced deterministic assignment across instruction templates; modes are orthogonal metadata, not counted as separate mechanisms. Factual fullpassage templates retain plain text; coordinated cases assessed jointly.

paired_controls: Same host,requested target vocabulary,matched insertion count; quoted or analytical harmless use retaining original evidence. Not an exhaustive natural-benign benchmark.

operating_points.primary: Higher99th percentile of independent normalcalibration scores, reject strictlygreater
operating_points.secondary: Higher95th percentile of independent normalcalibration scores

statistics: Per-template/source/mode confusion counts andsingleclass recalls/FPR;precision/AP/AUC onlybalancedbothlabels. Articlepairedbootstrap2000seed20261022 where feasible, warnfewgroups. Jointcase maxscore not equated to an optimal jointdetector.
retrieval: Additional transparent exact word+bigram TFIDF corpus retrieval baseline,normaltestcorpus,top20filterbackfilltop5,pureappend. Authenticgoldneverremovedfromcorpus. Validateinsertionsortingagainstfullcorpus forspecifiedsample. This does not rerun original Contriever or generator.
external: InjecAgent1054fullcontextattackcases with62payloadparents/17taskparents; AgentDojo141deduplicated benign tooloutputs withall348archivedorigins. Passive archivedtext classification only.
execution_limits: New detector inference and exactTFIDFretrieval are executed; no pretrainedneuralforwardpasses,no LLMgeneratorcalls,no toolactions, no real exfiltration.
reporting: Keepnewconstruction counts,independentarticle/questioncounts,modes,externaldata andactualexecutions distinct; preserve all unfavorable results. Do not upgrade construction labels to verified attack success.
